grammar.pt: <first item> + 归 + <same first item>，<second item> + 归 + <same second item>
grammar.pr: <first item> + guī + <same first item>, <second item> + guī + <same second item>
grammar.ds: Treat two matters separately; one need not invalidate the other.

ex.translation: Business is business; friendship is a separate matter.

grammar.pt: <first option> + 也好，<second option> + 也好，<clause>
grammar.pr: <first option> + yě hǎo, <second option> + yě hǎo, <clause>
grammar.ds: Enumerate alternatives without changing the ensuing conclusion.

ex.translation: Whether we take the train or fly, we will arrive on Friday.

grammar.ds: An involuntary reaction; 禁 is jīn.

ex.translation: She could not help laughing when she heard the news.

grammar.ds: At intervals, recurring from time to time.

ex.translation: He waits for his friend at the station, glancing at his watch from time to time.

grammar.ds: Acting reveals an unexpected contrast to the prior untested state.

ex.translation: I had no idea until I did the sums; only then did I discover we were a hundred yuan short.

grammar.ds: An inanimate cause brings about an affected object's result.

ex.translation: The strong wind blew the door open.

grammar.ds: Beyond a usual limit or category; established super-/ultra- formations.

ex.translation: This is an ultra-large aircraft.

grammar.ds: The exceptional condition is necessary for the result.

ex.translation: I will only pay if you sign.

grammar.ds: Unless the exception holds, the default consequence follows.

ex.translation: Unless it rains tomorrow, the match will take place on schedule.

grammar.ds: Exclude a specified member or case from the following claim.

ex.translation: Everyone except me agrees.

grammar.ds: The actual development is contrary to expectation.

ex.translation: He got to the airport early, only to find that the flight had been canceled.

grammar.ds: Set the inclusive stopping boundary of a range or activity.

ex.translation: By Friday, fifty people had signed up.

grammar.ds: Concede or contrast a noteworthy fact against the context.

ex.translation: The room is small, but the view from the window is actually rather nice.

grammar.ds: Enough; stop or dismiss further discussion, depending on tone.

ex.translation: Enough, stop explaining; I understand now.

grammar.ds: Scattered acts or items; often suggests disorganized attention.

ex.translation: The toys are in piles here and there, and the room is a mess.

grammar.ds: Multiple elements or dimensions within a derived term.

ex.translation: He bought a multifunctional mobile phone.

grammar.ds: A burden, blame or unwelcome event comes upon someone.

ex.translation: Now the trouble has landed on me.

grammar.pt: <accepted event> + 了 + 就 + <same event> + 了
grammar.ds: Accept an accomplished fact rather than continue regretting it.

ex.translation: What's done is done; there is still time to put it right.

grammar.ds: Every case meeting the condition satisfies the stated rule.

ex.translation: Everyone who signs up needs to fill in this form.

grammar.ds: Opposition or reversal in a derived term.

ex.translation: Please install antivirus software.

grammar.ds: Leave an available resource or opportunity unused, usually critically.

ex.translation: With a bus available, why insist on walking?

grammar.ds: Choose a straightforward, decisive course rather than hesitate.

ex.translation: The rain is so heavy; let's simply stay here.

grammar.ds: Hurry in response to an immediate circumstance.

ex.translation: She hurried to open the door when she heard the doorbell.

grammar.ds: Address someone with emphatic reproach or admiring surprise.

ex.translation: Well, you little artist! You paint really well!

grammar.pr: (hǎo róng yì / hǎo bù róng yì) + <verb phrase>
grammar.ds: Finally achieve with difficulty; this idiomatic reading depends on context.

ex.translation: We searched for ages and finally managed to find the key.

grammar.ds: Relatively so; a qualified, comparatively formal assessment.

ex.translation: The content of this report is relatively straightforward.

grammar.ds: Nothing but the stated activity, often with disapproval.

ex.translation: He does nothing but criticize other people's faults without looking at his own problems.

grammar.ds: Even accepting the hypothetical case leaves the outcome unchanged.

ex.translation: Even if it rains tomorrow, we will leave on time.

grammar.pt: (看 / 瞧) + 把 + <experiencing agent> + <predicate> + 得
grammar.ds: Exclaim at someone's pronounced reaction; trailing description may remain unspoken.

ex.translation: Look how delighted you are! You just got a present, didn't you?

grammar.ds: Exclaim at a visible manner or state, often teasing or reproachful.

ex.translation: Look how busy you are; you even forgot lunch!

grammar.ds: An evident fact, often contrasted with denial or contrary behavior.

ex.translation: The key is plainly on the table; how can you say you didn't see it?

grammar.pr: (nà dào shì / nà dào yě shì)
grammar.ds: Concede that the preceding point is indeed valid.

ex.translation: “Cheap things aren't necessarily good.” “That's true.”

grammar.ds: Strings/clusters or drops; select by the counted material.

ex.translation: I bought a bunch of grapes.

grammar.ds: Count rolled material or spools; 卷 is juǎn.

ex.translation: There are two rolls of paper on the table.

grammar.ds: Count book volumes or scrolls; 卷 is juàn.

ex.translation: This set of history books has six volumes in all.

grammar.ds: Slender stems or door/window leaves; 扇 is shàn here.

ex.translation: He gave me a rose.

grammar.pt: <first participant> + 一 + <measure word>，<second participant> + 一 + <measure word>
grammar.pr: <first participant> + yī + <measure word>, <second participant> + yī + <measure word>
grammar.ds: Distribute successive contributions or units across participants.

ex.translation: Everyone chipped in with one remark after another, and the discussion went on for a long time.

grammar.ds: A thorough or extreme result with compatible predicates.

ex.translation: The rain was so heavy that my clothes were soaked through.

grammar.ds: An exact fit or timely coincidence.

ex.translation: Three people and three chairs: exactly enough seats.

grammar.ds: Others or a contextually understood person; self-reference is socially marked.

ex.translation: He's already apologized; just forgive him.

grammar.ds: A prior state remains unchanged.

ex.translation: There are more tourists this year, but this street is still very quiet.

grammar.ds: The 把 object acts or experiences the resulting state, rather than simple manipulation.

ex.translation: That joke had me laughing my head off.

grammar.ds: Most members or cases, not all.

ex.translation: Most of these students live near the school.

grammar.ds: Participants act together.

ex.translation: We are going to visit the museum together.

grammar.ds: Become or make into a named state; derived processes or changes.

ex.translation: Production automation has improved efficiency.

grammar.ds: A style, method or pattern modeled on the stem.

ex.translation: This is a family-style inn.

grammar.ds: A type classified by the preceding feature.

ex.translation: We should build a resource-conserving society.

grammar.ds: An abstract property or character of the stem.

ex.translation: Please check the accuracy of the data.

grammar.ds: Animate an assertion or new situation; often fuses 了 and 啊.

ex.translation: Food's ready! Come and eat!

grammar.ds: Present a reason or fact as obvious/shared, often insistently.

ex.translation: Don't worry; we still have ten minutes, after all.

grammar.ds: Drop the matter or abandon the intended action.

ex.translation: Forget it; let's not buy it today. Let's go home first.

grammar.pt: 虽 + <concessive fact>，(但 / 可 / 却 / 也) + <clause>
grammar.ds: Concede a fact while limiting its expected consequence; concise register.

ex.translation: This method is simple, yet very effective.

grammar.ds: Formal nominal modification; the noun fills an understood object relation.

ex.translation: The report he wrote is very detailed.

grammar.ds: Act specifically for the purpose at issue, with special effort.

ex.translation: She made a special train journey to come and see me.

grammar.ds: A very high or unusually high degree; 特 is colloquial.

ex.translation: The wind is really strong today.

grammar.ds: Pause on a topic before commenting; colloquial stance.

ex.translation: As for the price, we can discuss it further.

grammar.ds: Act covertly, avoiding others' notice.

ex.translation: He secretly put the present on the table.

grammar.ds: Count extended bouts of effort, discussion or similar activity.

ex.translation: After a thorough discussion, we finally reached an agreement.

grammar.ds: The same action ranges over many things, often with impatience.

ex.translation: The child asked about this and that, and Dad answered patiently.

grammar.ds: Act to make a desired subsequent action possible.

ex.translation: Please send the notice in advance so everyone can plan their time.

grammar.ds: Deny certainty, not assert the opposite.

ex.translation: A high price does not necessarily mean good quality.

grammar.ds: Absence of the named property or component.

ex.translation: I drink sugar-free tea.

grammar.ds: Below or secondary to a category; only established technical formations.

ex.translation: He is studying suboptimal states of health.

grammar.pr: yào me + <first option>, yào me + <second option>
grammar.ds: Present a limited choice between alternatives.

ex.translation: Either you cook or I do.

grammar.pr: yī shí + <first clause>, yī shí + <second clause>
grammar.ds: Alternating transient states or actions.

ex.translation: The weather keeps switching between sunny and cloudy.

grammar.ds: A temporary situation or brief inability at the reference moment.

ex.translation: I cannot recall his name for the moment.

grammar.ds: A consistent habit or disposition over the relevant past.

ex.translation: She has always been punctual; why is she late today?

grammar.ds: Repeatedly, often with insistence; not an exact count of three.

ex.translation: The teacher repeatedly reminded us to hand in our homework on time.

grammar.ds: A concise formal cause phrase.

ex.translation: The flight was canceled because of the weather.

grammar.ds: Formal time or location link; placement depends on the verb and register.

ex.translation: The meeting begins at nine tomorrow morning.

grammar.pt: (早不 / 早也不) + <verb>，(晚不 / 晚也不) + <same verb>
grammar.pr: (zǎo bù / zǎo yě bù) + <verb>, (wǎn bù / wǎn yě bù) + <same verb>
grammar.ds: Complain that an action occurred at precisely an inconvenient time.

ex.translation: Of all times to arrive, you turn up just as I am about to go out.

grammar.pt: 这也不 + <first rejected predicate>，那也不 + <second rejected predicate>
grammar.pr: zhè yě bù + <first rejected predicate>, nà yě bù + <second rejected predicate>
grammar.ds: Reject successive options; 这 and 那 may reverse their order.

ex.translation: You won't eat this or that; what do you actually want to eat?

grammar.ds: Shift to a separate topic or aspect.

ex.translation: I have bought the tickets; as for accommodation, we can discuss that tomorrow.

grammar.ds: Near, prospective or quasi-membership in a category.

ex.translation: This expectant mother takes a walk every day.

grammar.ds: A satisfactory endpoint reached after difficulty or waiting.

ex.translation: He looked this way and that but still could not find the key.
